title: _is_within may silently fail on Windows path edge cases

finding.claim: _is_within may silently fail on Windows path edge cases
finding.recommendation: Add explicit platform guard or logging to surface when _is_within returns False due to ValueError on non-POSIX systems, or ensure the function is only called in POSIX contexts with validated paths.

refutation.reason: The code explicitly documents and implements a fail-closed behavior for ValueError cases, so returning False on Windows path edge cases is intentional rather than a silent correctness failure.

probe.summary: CLI probe (`probes/closingB_cli_core.py`, _is_within section): at HEAD (cli.py:85-100) an inside path returns True, an outside path False, and the simulated cross-drive ValueError returns False — the documented fail-closed behaviour, exercised. The supported-platform manifest adopted by the owner is POSIX-only (the closing record itself carries `supported_platforms: {'os': ['posix'], 'python': '>=3.11'}`); Windows path semantics are out of scope by decision, and where they can arise the helper fails closed rather than silently passing.
